items.title: UB expects Q3 profit growth to moderate on rising costs
items.description: United Breweries expects slower profit growth this quarter as raw material costs and marketing expenses increase. Regulatory delays are inhibiting price increases for nearly 30% of their operations, particularly in southern states. The company forecasts gross margins to decline slightly from the previous quarter's figures. United Breweries is prioritizing profitability over market share in specific regions amid intensified competition.

items.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 net profit falls 55% despite 75% increase in revenue
items.description: Adani Enterprises saw a 55% drop in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Revenue from operations increased by 75%, reaching ₹37,216 crore compared to the previous year. A notable decline in profit was attributed to an exceptional gain a year prior, while expenses rose sharply. The company plans to invest ₹35,000 crore to ₹40,000 crore annually in airports and data centres.

items.title: HUL sales rise 15% to hit 14-quarter high, but inflation clouds demand outlook
items.description: Hindustan Unilever posted a turnover of ₹18,071 crore for the September quarter, highlighting a 15% rise. Even with a price increase of 7.5%, the company's volume growth remained stable at 7%. Homecare emerged as the standout performer, boasting a robust 22% sales growth. Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortisation climbed to ₹4,089 crore, an 8% boost. However, ongoing inflation and wage issues in rural sectors pose significant challenges.

items.title: Vedanta cuts debt by Rs 4,624 crore in September quarter as net profit jumps 151%
items.description: Vedanta reported significant financial growth, achieving record revenue and net profit in the September quarter. The company's consolidated revenue increased by 57% year-on-year to ₹25,812 crore while Ebitda doubled to ₹9,938 crore. After a recent demerger, Vedanta plans to eliminate debt, nearing completion in the upcoming quarter. The company has successfully reduced its debt by nearly ₹10,000 crore in recent months. Shares of Vedanta closed 3.
